source_notes: Items from the paper-and-pencil O*NET Interest Profiler Short Form (IPSF_PP.pdf, 'Developed by the National Center for O*NET Development (v1)'), extracted via WebFetch section by section; 10 per RIASEC area. 'index' here is our own sequential numbering in PDF reading order (row by row, left column item then right column item, sections R,I,A,S,E,C). The O*NET Web Services API (services.onetcenter.org/reference/mnm/ip/ip_questions) uses a different index order (its example shows index 1 = 'Build kitchen cabinets', index 2 = 'Lay brick or tile', both realistic); the full API list was not visible on the reference page.
options_note: 5-point options as documented on the O*NET Web Services reference page (mnm/ip/ip_questions; Spanish mpp version: 1 'Me disgusta mucho', 2 'Me disgusta', 3-5 not shown). The paper Short Form instead uses a single checkbox per item ('place a check by each one you would like to do'; score = number of checks per area; top three areas reported).
